title: The face peeler legend of the Peruvian Amazon
summary: Tim Alberino tells of The face peeler legend of the Peruvian Amazon, about mid-1980s onward at Amazon, Peru, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's the the faith face peeler legend goes back to the 80s, like the mid 80s. And it it doesn't go further than that.

plain: Tim Alberino, a filmmaker and researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, talks about a local legend in the Peruvian Amazon about a so-called face peeler. He says the legend only goes back to the mid-1980s and no further. He raises the date because a legend that recent may point to something that actually started happening then.
